title: Observations upon the Prophecies of Daniel, and the Apocalypse of St. John

verification_log.method: Downloaded and read Part I chs. 6–8

Ten horns = ten kingdoms into which the Western Roman Empire broke; the little horn is a kingdom, "a Seer, a Prophet and a King … the Church of Rome", rising to temporal dominion in the later 8th century; time, times and half a time = 1260 solar years (day-year); rejects Antiochus for the little horn of ch. 8

access_notes: Read through the Gutenberg text (pglaf mirror), Part I chs. 4–8.
